messages:
Jordan: FYI — Customer acme-inc reporting that their marketplace credits (AWS/GCP/Azure) aren't being applied to invoices after they switched their subscription plan yesterday. They say the billing portal still shows "Marketplace credit: $0.00" even though AWS dashboard shows a credit grant.

Maya: Can you paste the customer's Redwood account ID + the marketplace subscription/order ID? Also which marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure)?

Jordan: Redwood acct: ACME-3482; AWS Marketplace order: 0123456789AB; provider: aws. Customer also tried GCP promo from the accelerator program — gave code ACCEL-2025 — but that doesn't appear anywhere either. Screenshot link from customer: https://files.example.com/acme-credit-mismatch.png

marketplace-bot: Scheduled reconciliation job for marketplace-credits (aws, us-east-1) failed at 2024-04-25T16:12:03Z — upstream 403 Forbidden from provider billing API. Retry scheduled in 1h.

Liam: Thanks. This looks like a reconciliation failure. Can you run the internal credit lookup and paste output? e.g.:
```
GET /v1/billing/marketplace-credits?account_id=ACME-3482&provider=aws
```
We need invoice IDs (if any) where the credit was expected to apply and the customer's marketplace invoice/order reference.

Jordan: Ran the lookup, output below:
```
{
  "account_id": "ACME-3482",
  "provider": "aws",
  "credits": [],
  "error": "403 Forbidden: access denied to provider billing API (token_scope_mismatch)"
}
```
Customer-provided AWS order id: 0123456789AB. They expect ~ $500 in credits. They hit an invoice on 2024-04-24 (inv-2024-0416).

Raj: Noted. 403 from provider API usually means our marketplace token lost permission or the seller-side grant hasn't been accepted. Sophie, can you check partner-console for AWS/GCP connectors? Also check whether the vendor account's reconciliation role ARN changed recently.

Sophie: Looking now — I see the AWS connector for the marketplace integration shows "OAuth consent revoked" and last successful sync: 2024-04-20T03:04:12Z. For GCP the accelerator grant appears in pending state (ACCEL-2025) — no finalization callback received. Azure connector shows last sync 2024-04-18 and a warning: credential rotation detected.

Sophie: Immediate next steps I suggest:
- Re-authorize AWS marketplace connector (re-run seller-consent flow)
- Re-send acceptance callback for ACCEL-2025 to our webhook endpoint /webhooks/partner/grants
- Re-provision rotated Azure credentials in vault and re-run sync
Docs: https://internal.docs.redwood/partner/marketplace-reconciliation (internal)

Maya: For ACME-3482 we should do a manual temporary credit while we fix the reconciliation to avoid impacting their production usage. Please confirm amount and get a customer ok. I'll mark as P1 for billing impact.

Jordan: Customer confirmed they're happy with an immediate manual grant of $500 to cover April invoices. They've asked for a timeline and a postmortem on why credits didn't apply. Ticket: #5678. Please CC me on the follow-up.

Liam: I'll create the manual credit:
```
POST /v1/billing/credits
{ "account_id": "ACME-3482", "amount": 50000, "currency": "USD", "reason": "Marketplace credits not applied (manual relief)" }
```
I'll follow up with accounting to ensure it reflects on inv-2024-0416.

Raj: Engineering will re-run the reconciliation once Sophie confirms connectors are re-authorized. Also adding an audit: capture provider API response headers and token scopes for the failing calls so we can trace why 403 was returned.

Sophie: Done — re-authorized AWS connector and re-sent GCP acceptance callback. Azure creds rotated successfully in vault and sync restarted. I'll kick the reconciliation job now.

marketplace-bot: Manual reconciliation requested for account ACME-3482 — job started at 2024-04-25T16:28:12Z.

Jordan: Customer notified about manual $500 credit and that we're re-running reconciliation. They want a follow-up email and a short postmortem in 48h.

Maya: I'll draft the customer note and create the postmortem stub. Action items: (1) Liam confirm credit posted to invoice, (2) Sophie confirm reconciler completes without 403, (3) Raj attach API scope logs to postmortem.

Liam: Credit posted and invoice updated (inv-2024-0416). Confirmed with accounting. Closing immediate billing gap.

Raj: Reconciler completed successfully after re-auth — AWS credits populated for ACME-3482, GCP accelerator grant applied (ACCEL-2025), Azure sync OK. Pushing short postmortem to /pm/marketplace-recon/ACME-3482.

Jordan: Customer replied: "Thanks — confirmed credit applied and production unaffected. Appreciate the quick turnaround." :thumbsup:

Maya: Closing loop here. We'll keep the postmortem and follow-up remediation (improved alerts for revoked consent) in the next sprint. :white_check_mark:
